document: Frozen per-page root and atomic version-set qualification contract
status: proposed bounded experiment; all cases not-run
purpose: Qualify production partition candidate without treating aggregate21/22 as a final format or duplicating transaction engines

fixture.media: reuse independently verified22 PNG/PDF source fixtures
fixture.performance_targets: none accepted here; qualification-budgets.json remains Proposed

implementation_constraints: One Space SQLite store/commit owner; independently versioned page engine state
Canonical task body/title/properties once; note-owned slot; index derived and transactional
No UI/CLI/MCP filesystem or SQL bypass, no copied reducer
Coherent historical version-set context and transitive pin references
Old aggregate profile retained; reuse/factor common transaction primitive rather than fork
Use marked disposable stores; no production/main/user vault or old native sessions
Respect known environment browser block; label actual interface route, do not infer native/browser pass

cases.title: Canonical page partition and lazy engine boundaries
cases.action: Create3 notes/2 independent task pages with stable IDs/properties and valid22 media. Load requested pages through the real owner.
cases.expected: One payload per page; task slots/derived placement index have one mutation path. Unknown root/codec refuses overwrite. Record loads and deep-check cost, not a fake startup budget pass.

cases.title: One page edit does not serialize other pages
cases.action: Edit one paragraph through shared command; compare all immutable payload rows/heads and instrument actual encoding/writes.
cases.expected: Only affected page engine payload is encoded/persisted. No whole-Space Y state or new database per page. Metadata write amplification is separately reported.

cases.title: Atomic task move across page heads
cases.action: Move task from note1 to note2 while preserving canonical task body/properties/cover.
cases.expected: One SQL transaction changes both note heads and derived unique placement index plus original receipt; task payload unchanged. At most one active placement, no duplicated bytes/body.

cases.title: Historical note resolves historical task without copied body
cases.action: Pin note snapshot at commit C, change only referenced task title/body/cover later, then read old note snapshot.
cases.expected: Old note resolves task and assets as of C, not current task. Note own unchanged head is not enough: coherent version-set context retained without embedding copied task body. A current view of the same unchanged note payload resolves the newer task/cover; do not bind all reads to note payload creation time.

cases.title: Historical restore rechecks current ownership
cases.action: Move/detach task after pinned old note, preview restore, change ownership again, attempt restore. Also restore plain note text when ownership remains unchanged.
cases.expected: Conflicting/stale restore refuses with no heads/index/outcome effect. Safe note-content restore does not rewind independent newer task body/properties/cover.

cases.title: Transitive pinned media/root closure
cases.action: Pin version set containing task/page PNG/PDF, remove all current associations, restart and read old snapshot.
cases.expected: Pin references retain required task/page roots, codecs/dependencies and immutable files; read validates bytes. No current fallback, body copy, GC or unsafe orphan adoption.

cases.title: Real crash old-or-new multi-page state
cases.action: Kill actual owner around root staging/head/index/outcome/COMMIT/reply; reopen and exact-retry same request.
cases.expected: All involved heads/index/Space commit/outcome recover old or new, never half move. Exact retry one effect; changed operation-ID reuse refused. Reuse/factor one transaction engine.

cases.title: Coherent old/new readers and stale commands
cases.action: Hold explicit immutable snapshot lease, commit task move/body edit, query old/new readers and submit old expected-head command.
cases.expected: Each reader gets one coherent version set. No indefinite SQL read transaction for window lifetime; stale mutation fails. Report lease semantics; no GC expiry implies permission to discard pending work.

cases.title: Client parity and revision-tagged catch-up
cases.action: Use RPC/CLI/MCP for same mutation, pause observer across multi-page commit, resume from watermark.
cases.expected: One command catalogue/handler/receipt. Notifications are hints; catch-up fetches authoritative affected heads/version set. No per-interface writer or partial authoritative publication.

cases.title: Structural amplification and decision inputs
cases.action: Compare aggregate control and page candidate on declared fixture; record bytes encoded/written, roots touched, open/deep-check work and complete format/runtime profile.
cases.expected: No performance pass from tiny fixture or skipped validation. D11 targets/reference host and Space-size/active-Space dimensions fixed separately before representative measurement. Failure/unsupported results retained.

exit: Bounded PK results reviewed with G-Q format/performance/native/runtime/security blockers; no automatic production baseline or feature release acceptance
